title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Medium vs. High effort
subtitle: Same 7/7 pass. Half the turns, 53% lower cost.
description: 7-slide comparison of Gemini 4 Carbon at Medium vs. High effort on Antigravity CLI: 97 vs. 198 turns, $3.35 vs. $7.16, 53m vs. 88m, and 7/7 holdouts.
seoTitle: Gemini 4 Carbon: Medium vs. High Effort
seoDescription: Gemini 4 Carbon Medium vs. High on Antigravity CLI: 7/7 pass, 97 vs. 198 turns, 53m vs. 88m, and $3.35 vs. $7.16.

slides.label: COVER
slides.headlineMuted: Same 7/7 pass for half the cost.
slides.lead: On Antigravity CLI, **Medium** passed all **7/7** stages in **53m** for **$3.35**. **High** took **88m** and **$7.16**.

slides.label: WHY COST FELL 53%
slides.headlinePrimary: Fewer turns saved more than shorter thinking.

slides.label: HEAD TO HEAD
slides.headlinePrimary: Medium is now the cheapest Gemini 4 run.
slides.footnote: * With zero stalls and the same 96.39% cache hit rate, High still costs $6.30.

slides.label: WHAT STAYED & CHANGED
slides.headlinePrimary: Same code design. One startup fix.

steps.title: Same HTTP & TLS stack
steps.desc: Both inspected OTP 28 bytecode first and built zero-dependency `:gen_tcp` and `:ssl` clients.

steps.title: Medium stopped at the spec
steps.desc: Passed `36/36` tests, `0` Credo issues, and `Ctrl-C` after `350 ms` (`8` release turns).

steps.title: High fixed early Ctrl-C
steps.desc: Tested `50–550 ms` `Ctrl-C` delays and added `CB_READY_FILE` for cold BEAM boot (`26` release turns).

callout.title: Half the Turns on Every Stage
callout.body: Turns dropped `46%–58%` across S1–S7. S3 fell `43 → 19` turns; S7 fell `19 → 8`.

slides.label: SMALL VS LARGE MODELS
slides.headlinePrimary: Small models need High. Large models don't.

steps.title: GLM-5.3-Flash Low (6/7)
steps.desc: Looped for `344` turns (`$1.10`, `111m`) and failed live chunked `301` responses.

steps.title: GLM-5.3-Flash High (7/7)
steps.desc: Planned upfront, finished in `190` turns (`$0.87`, `71m`), and passed all `7/7` stages.

steps.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Medium (7/7)
steps.desc: Already knew OTP 28, so **Medium** finished in `97` turns while **High** took `198` one-tool steps.

callout.title: Set Effort by Model Size
callout.body: Use **High** on small models to prevent loops. Use **Medium** on large models to cut slow micro-steps.

items.head: 300 ms startup gap on Medium
items.text: Sending `Ctrl-C` during the first `300 ms` of BEAM boot exits `130` before printing a summary.

items.head: Cache resets added $0.86 to High
items.text: High had `5` mid-run cache resets (`94.68%` hit). Medium had `1` (`96.39%` hit).

items.head: Most tool errors were TDD tests
items.text: Of `36` errors, `20` were planned failing `mix test` runs and `5` were Credo checks. `108/109` file edits worked.

items.head: Low effort not tested yet
items.text: Only **Medium** and **High** were tested on Carbon. **Low** may still drop below `7/7`.

slides.label: TAKEAWAYS
slides.headlineMuted: When to use Medium vs. High.

items.head: Default Carbon to Medium
items.text: Same `7/7` score, `35m` faster (`53m` vs `88m`), and `53%` cheaper (`$3.35` vs `$7.16`).

items.head: Check tools per turn
items.text: Batching `2.01` tools per turn cut prompt-cache replays in half and lowered tokens by `59%`.

items.head: Use High for race bugs
items.text: Spend `2×` for **High** only when sub-`250 ms` startup or signal races matter.
